title: index.md must be fetchable, non-empty, and non-erroring
untested_rationale: presenceFindings() in audits/checks/b2-llms.mjs emits this bare id under three distinct conditions (the mechanism is unchanged from the retired validate-llms-txt.mjs checkPresence(); atlas decision 0119 D2 folded it into b2-llms.mjs and this rationale still named the dead file until the 0142 phase 7 sweep) -- a thrown fetch error, a non-2xx HTTP status, and an empty body -- and looks the id up in PRESENCE_IDS rather than naming a literal, so it cannot be exercised by a pure-function input. Covered instead by the production smoke suite's prod-domain route assertions (audits.yaml B1, the same incident class as llms-full-txt above).
rationale: index.md has no formal spec of its own -- it is a CloudFront-only artifact this repo composes and serves; this id covers its own operational presence/emptiness handling.
applicability: N/A -- fires on a transport or emptiness failure, not on parsed content.
